---
title: "Baseline Accessibility — Main Manuscript Figure 2"
format: html
---

# Baseline accessibility and delta travel time maps (main manuscript).
# Generates Figure 2: two-panel baseline travel time to (a) all
# healthcare facilities and (b) hospitals only.

## Setup
```{r}
source(here::here("Code/utils/loading_utils.R"))
source(here::here("Code/utils/export_utils.R"))
source(here::here("Code/00_scenario_definitions.R"))

load_processed_data()
filter_facilities()
```

## Figure 2 — Combined Baseline Map
```{r}
# Travel time colour ramp and bin breaks (minutes); breaks are interior boundaries.
tt_breaks <- c(15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120)
tt_colors_main <- viridisLite::turbo(length(tt_breaks) + 1)

# Replicate the coordinate-shift pipeline from 02_Baseline_geography.qmd
# to derive a consistent plotting extent (geog_extent)
lc_path <- here("Data", "raw", "Landcover", "ESA_WorldCover_10m_2021_v200_N00E030_Map.tif")
landcover_complete <- rast(lc_path)
landcover_complete <- project(landcover_complete, Landcover)
landcover_complete <- crop(landcover_complete, Landcover)

raw_fac_path <- here("Data", "raw", "Facilities", "suhsharan_health_facilities", "sub-saharan_health_facilities.shp")
fac_complete_ref <- vect(raw_fac_path)
fac_complete_ref <- project(fac_complete_ref, Landcover)
fac_complete_ref <- crop(fac_complete_ref, Landcover)

names(fac_complete_ref)[names(fac_complete_ref) %in% c("Facility.n", "Facility n")] <- "Facility_n"

fac_processed <- if (inherits(Facilities, "list")) {
  idx <- which(names(Facilities) == "facilities_all_kampala")
  if (length(idx) > 0) Facilities[[idx]] else Facilities[[1]]
} else {
  Facilities
}

# Compute coordinate shift (dx, dy) from matched facility positions
common_ids <- intersect(as.character(fac_complete_ref$Facility_n), as.character(fac_processed$Facility_n))
idx_c <- match(common_ids, as.character(fac_complete_ref$Facility_n))
idx_s <- match(common_ids, as.character(fac_processed$Facility_n))

coords_c <- crds(fac_complete_ref)
coords_s <- crds(fac_processed)

dx <- mean(coords_s[idx_s, 1] - coords_c[idx_c, 1], na.rm = TRUE)
dy <- mean(coords_s[idx_s, 2] - coords_c[idx_c, 2], na.rm = TRUE)

landcover_complete <- shift(landcover_complete, dx, dy)
geog_extent        <- ext(landcover_complete)

# Build contextual facility layers (shifted reference data)
names(fac_complete_ref)[names(fac_complete_ref) %in% c("Facility.t", "Facility t")] <- "Facility_t"
names(fac_complete_ref)[names(fac_complete_ref) %in% c("LL.source", "LL source")]   <- "LL_source"

facilities_complete_ctx <- shift(fac_complete_ref, dx, dy)

hospitals_complete <- facilities_complete_ctx[facilities_complete_ctx$Facility_t %in% 
                                                c("National Referral Hospital", "Hospital", "Regional Referral Hospital"), ]
health_centers_complete <- facilities_complete_ctx[facilities_complete_ctx$Facility_t %in% 
                                                   c("Health Centre III", "Health Centre II", "Health Centre IV"), ]

message(paste0("Diagnostic: Rebuilt context with ", nrow(hospitals_complete), " hospitals and ", 
               nrow(health_centers_complete), " health centres."))

# --- Panel A: All Facilities ---
p_a_main <- ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = base_tt_all) +
  scale_fill_stepsn(
    name = "Travel Time (min)",
    colours = tt_colors_main,
    breaks = tt_breaks,
    limits = c(0, 180),
    oob = scales::squish,
    na.value = "transparent",
    guide = guide_coloursteps(
      show.limits = TRUE,
      title.position = "top",
      barwidth = unit(4.5, "cm"),
      barheight = unit(0.35, "cm"),
      order = 1
    )
  ) +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  
  geom_sf(data = sf::st_as_sf(Parish_boundaries), color = "gray20", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.2) +
  
  # Contextual facilities (semi-transparent, outside AOI)
  geom_sf(data = sf::st_as_sf(hospitals_complete), aes(shape = "Hospitals (outside study area)"), fill = scales::alpha("black", 0.4), color = scales::alpha("black", 0.5), size = 1.2) +
  geom_sf(data = sf::st_as_sf(health_centers_complete), aes(shape = "Health centres (outside study area)"), fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.4), color = scales::alpha("black", 0.5), size = 0.8) +

  # Study area facilities (solid)
  geom_sf(data = sf::st_as_sf(hospitals_main), aes(shape = "Hospitals"), fill = "black", color = "white", size = 2) +
  geom_sf(data = sf::st_as_sf(health_centres_main), aes(shape = "Health centres"), fill = "white", color = "black", size = 1.2) +

  # `limits` fixes legend order; the override.aes vectors below are positional.
  scale_shape_manual(
    name = "Facilities",
    limits = c("Health centres", "Hospitals",
               "Health centres (outside study area)", "Hospitals (outside study area)"),
    values = c("Health centres" = 21, "Hospitals" = 23,
               "Health centres (outside study area)" = 21, "Hospitals (outside study area)" = 23)
  ) +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(
    ncol = 1,
    title.position = "top",
    label.position = "right",
    override.aes = list(
      fill  = c("white", "black", "white", "black"),
      color = c("black", "black", "black", "black"),
      size  = 3.5,
      alpha = c(1, 1, 0.4, 0.4)
    ),
    order = 2
  )) +
  
  ggspatial::annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.2, text_cex = 0.6,
                              unit_category = "metric", style = "bar") +

  coord_sf(xlim = c(geog_extent[1], geog_extent[2]),
           ylim = c(geog_extent[3], geog_extent[4]), expand = FALSE) +

  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.box.just = "top",
    legend.spacing.x = unit(1, "cm"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.margin = margin(t = 10, b = 5),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)
  )

# --- Panel B: Hospitals Only ---
p_b_main <- ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = base_tt_hosp) +
  scale_fill_stepsn(
    colours = tt_colors_main, 
    breaks = tt_breaks, 
    limits = c(0, 180),
    oob = scales::squish,
    na.value = "transparent",
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  
  geom_sf(data = sf::st_as_sf(Parish_boundaries), color = "gray20", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.2) +
  
  geom_sf(data = sf::st_as_sf(hospitals_complete), shape = 23, fill = scales::alpha("black", 0.4), color = scales::alpha("black", 0.5), size = 1.2) +
  geom_sf(data = sf::st_as_sf(hospitals_main), shape = 23, fill = "black", color = "white", size = 2) +
  
  ggspatial::annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.2, text_cex = 0.6,
                              unit_category = "metric", style = "bar") +

  coord_sf(xlim = c(geog_extent[1], geog_extent[2]),
           ylim = c(geog_extent[3], geog_extent[4]), expand = FALSE) +

  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)
  )

# Combine panels and export
fig2_combined_main <- (p_a_main + p_b_main + plot_layout(guides = "collect")) & 
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.box.just = "top",
    legend.spacing.x = unit(1, "cm"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
  )

fig2_combined_main <- patchwork::wrap_elements(full = fig2_combined_main) + 
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1))

# Title: Baseline walking accessibility to public and PNFP healthcare facilities and hospitals.
# Caption: Travel time in minutes from each location to the nearest public or PNFP healthcare facility and to the nearest public or PNFP hospital under baseline conditions, assuming walking as the sole mode of transport. a, Nearest public or PNFP healthcare facility. b, Nearest public or PNFP hospital. Parish boundaries are shown for orientation, and healthcare facility locations are overlaid. Data sources: Master Facility List (2019); ESA WorldCover 2021; SRTM 30 m DEM (2018); OpenStreetMap contributors (extract 8 January 2025, ODbL 1.0); UBOS administrative boundaries (2018).
save_manuscript_pdf(fig2_combined_main, "Figure 2", subdir = "Main", width = 18, height = 13)

# --- Source Data Export ---
# Figure 2 is a pixel-level raster map. Due to its size (>1M rows), 
# it exceeds Excel's row limit. The original raster data is available 
# via Zenodo (see Data Availability section in the manuscript).
```
